description: USCIS's own I-485 figures: the newest quarter's receipts, approvals, denials and pending at every field office and service center, employment-based beside family-based and every category together. It adds the pending employment-based inventory with its history, and the median and posted processing times. Each part carries its own date. Example: {}.
